notes: No genuine seasonal/holiday category exists on kare.de as of this check (2026-09-03). Checked: (1) robots.txt - no Claude-specific disallow, general disallow only on /account/, /cart/, /checkout/, /w/, /payment-redirect/, /register/, /search/, /f/ (filtered results); sitemap.xml itself is behind a Cloudflare bot-challenge (tier-1 blocked for that one resource only, not the site). (2) Rendered homepage mega menu via Playwright: MOEBEL, LEUCHTEN, ACCESSOIRES, WOHNBEREICHE, NEUHEITEN, BESTSELLER, SUMMER SALE, INSPIRATIONEN, FILIALEN, Einrichtungsberatung, Geschaeftskunden - no holiday/seasonal branch. (3) Footer sitemap tree (5 branches: Moebel, Accessoires, Leuchten, Wohnbereiche, Bestseller) with their listed sub-categories - no seasonal node. (4) Full BFS crawl of the site's /c/ category graph starting from every discovered category link, expanded until the graph closed with no new links: 151 unique category pages reached (Moebel, Leuchten, Accessoires incl. Dekoration/Kerzen & Leuchter/Vasen/Figuren & Skulpturen/etc., Wohnbereiche, Bestseller, Sale, Neuheiten, Geschenke fuer Maenner/Frauen/Verpacken/kleine Geschenke-Wichtel/Glamour, outdoor, storage, textiles). Checked every slug for German and English seasonal/holiday terms (weihnacht/christmas, halloween, ostern/easter, silvester/new year, valentin, advent, herbst/autumn, fruehling/spring, sommer/summer, winter, diwali, fasching/karneval, nikolaus, saison, festlich, feiertag) - zero matches. (5) Directly probed plausible seasonal slugs (/c/weihnachten, /c/weihnachtsdeko, /c/weihnachtsartikel, /c/weihnachtsdekoration, /c/halloween, /c/ostern, /c/silvester, /c/valentinstag, /c/advent, /c/adventskalender, /c/weihnachtsbaum, /c/weihnachtsschmuck) - each returns the site's GraphQL categoryBySlug null-field error (page does not exist), confirming these are not live categories. (6) Checked the Inspirationen (editorial/magazine) landing page - no seasonal articles or seasonal category links indexed there either. (7) Internal site search (/search/) is disallowed by robots.txt for all crawlers and was not used, consistent with the rule that search is unreliable proof anyway. Kare.de appears to run its Christmas/holiday assortment as a later-in-year seasonal launch (typical for German retail, usually Oct/Nov) rather than a year-round taxonomy node; none is live at the time of this check.
